identity.title: [v0.92.1][Runtime] Replace brittle fixed reload deadlines with configurable convergence

review_prompts: Are all former fixed service-control waits replaced by named validated policy values?
Can slow successful convergence complete without a premature failure?
Does each real expiry identify its exact stage and preserve recovery?
Is launchd or systemd continuously authoritative with no direct competing Runtime?
Are unrelated API timeout and live Runtime behavior unchanged?
residual_risk: The focused validation intentionally did not restart or reload the live Runtime; operational rollout remains a separate operator-controlled action.
